description: Work out the break-even point of a product or service. Send fixed costs for the period, the selling price per unit and the variable cost per unit, and optionally a forecast of units and a profit target. Get back the contribution margin per unit and as a percent of price, the break-even units (exact and rounded up to whole units) and break-even revenue, the units and revenue needed to reach a profit target, and, against your forecast, the margin of safety in units, revenue and percent and the profit or loss at the forecast. Says plainly when there is no break-even because the price does not cover the variable cost. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/break-even-units). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

fixed_costs.description: Fixed costs for the period (rent, salaries, insurance: costs that do not change with units).

forecast_units.description: Optional: forecast units for the same period, to get the margin of safety.

label.description: Optional label (product or period, your own text, echoed back; not a person).

price_per_unit.description: Selling price per unit (up to 4 decimals).

target_profit.description: Optional: operating profit you want before tax, for the units and revenue needed to reach it.

variable_cost_per_unit.description: Variable cost per unit (materials, direct labor, commissions, per-unit fees; up to 4 decimals).

name: break_even_units
title: Break-Even Units and Revenue
